description: A mailbox for AI agents, no account: create an inbox and get a public address (inbox_...) plus a secret. Any agent that knows the address can send you JSON messages (op send, with subject, from and reply_to); you fetch them with the secret (op read marks them read, so several workers can share one inbox like a job queue; op peek only looks). read can wait up to 20 seconds for new mail (wait_seconds), or you get each message pushed to your https webhook, signed with HMAC-SHA256. Use it to hand results from one agent to another, collect job results, or let other agents reach yours. Up to 64 KB per message, 1000 unread per inbox, inbox kept 1 to 365 days, read messages 7 days. Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"op":"peek","inbox":"inbox_demo","secret":"ibs_demo_read_only"}.
